name: velabreakout/breakouts
description: Rank the fastest-growing AI apps, models, dev tools, software or companies in one group.

group.description: Which group to rank (ids from /groups): ai_apps (AI tokens an app uses), ai_models (tokens a model serves a week), ai_labs (each lab's share of all AI tokens), ai_work (open jobs paying experts to train and test AI models), open_models (open model downloads), editor_extensions and open_editor_extensions (code editor extension installs), workplace_add_ons (workplace suite add-on installs), browser_extensions (browser extensions, measured by reviews), agent_skills (agent skill installs a week), agent_tools (MCP server downloads a week), company_packages (downloads of a company's developer packages), business_software (adoption on a business-spend panel), web_technologies (websites running a technology), company_hiring (open roles on a company's careers page), company_buzz (points on a large tech news forum).

limit.description: How many rows to return, 1-25. The price is the same for any limit.

steady.description: When true, keep only items that are also up over a longer window — use it for 'steadily', 'sustained' or 'starting to' questions, to drop one-off spikes. A group with no longer window answers an empty ranking.

min_size.description: Size floor: only items at least as big as the group's median (the default), its 75th percentile, or none. A floor keeps tiny starts from dominating the ranking.

window_days.description: Growth window in days: 7, 30, 90 or 365. Omit to use the group's default (usually `usual_window_days` from /groups); the answer's `window` states the one used.
